params.body:
The term report and the progress report, on the design system. No change to
what a report says: `ReportService` and the DTOs are untouched, and the 24
report snapshots differ only in the class string that names a colour.

## The score cells

The colour on a cell means something (`ValueColor`: red is score 1, orange 2,
green 3, blue 4, grey absent), so it stays on the whole cell, as it was. What
changed is how the five bands are drawn:

- They were the Tailwind fills (`bg-red-500`, `bg-emerald-500`, ...) with a
  different text colour per band: white on red, near-black on blue, light grey
  on orange. Four bands that read as four different things.
- They are now five `score-*` utilities in `app.css`: flat fills in oklch on
  one lightness (85%) and one chroma (0.10), text as the dark step of the same
  hue. One scale that changes hue. Blue, the top band, is the only one with
  more chroma (0.16) and a touch less light (82%), so a column saturates
  upward. Orange sits at hue 58 rather than the print hue 46.6 and green at 150
  rather than 145, because the print hues read as peach and mint at that
  lightness; the reasons are in the CSS comment so nobody corrects them back.
- Gradient and highlight were both tried and dropped: they clashed with the
  rest of the page.
- The colour sits on a block of fixed height in the cell (`h-11`, `h-8` for
  attainment levels), not on the cell: it stays on the line of the course name
  and no longer stretches with three lines of feedback under it. Square corners
  and medium weight, so they read as cells and not as buttons.
- `ValueColor::tailwindClasses()` returns those utilities. `hexColor()` for
  print is untouched.

## The rows

- The course name is the main text (`ink-900`, medium). It sat on `ink-500`,
  greyer than the feedback under it.
- "Feedback:" as a label is gone; the text sits under the course in `ink-600`
  with the teacher after it in `ink-400`, no dash.
- A chevron before each course says the row expands and turns when it does.
  Expanded attainment levels hang on one guide line at the left, with the code
  in mono; where the line stops, the course stops. One device, not a band plus
  two rules: that was tried and was busy.
- The numbers in expanded rows were off centre because of the `-ml-5 -mb-5`
  wrapper the score popup hung on; the margins are gone and the popup hangs on
  the cell itself.
- The general feedback is a card with a quiet label and the teacher on a line
  of its own. The table is a card: ring and soft shadow instead of `shadow` plus
  border. Column heads sit right-aligned over the cells; the empty "." head is
  an `sr-only` "Vak".
- The header button reads "Afdrukken" instead of "print".

## The score popup

`ListOfScores.vue` in popup mode is a lifted card (`ring-1`, `shadow-lg`) above
the cell instead of a bordered box to its left. The average is a quiet label
with the number right; per evaluation the type, date and teacher sit small
above the title, the feedback under it, and the score at the right in the cell
of its band, the same `score-*` as the table. The type labels were in colours
of their own (blue, green, indigo); they are `ink` now, because colour here is
for the score. Two fixes on the way: the card wrapper had `overflow-hidden` for
its rounded corners and clipped the popup, and there was a gap between trigger
and popup that the cursor fell through, so you could never reach the links to
the evaluations. The corners are on the head now and the popup has no gap.

## Phone

At 390px the fixed table split its columns evenly and the course names wrapped
one word per line. The course column has a fixed width on small screens, the
score columns a smaller one, and the table scrolls sideways inside the card
with the first score column in view.

`TableSection.vue` also draws the progress report, which gets the same rows
with its progress bar and the same scrolling.

## Checks

- `php artisan test`: 196 passed, 1 failed (`BuildStampTest`, worktree only);
  `ReportSnapshotTest` and `ValueColorTest` green.
- `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`: no errors. `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed.
- `npm run build`, `npm run lint`: 0 errors, the 12 pre-existing warnings.
params.title: Het periodiek rapport en het vooruitgangsrapport op het design system
